jobs.name: SKL-B01_motion_01_slash_beam_v001
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent 2D pixel-art game CHARACTER BODY animation sprite sheet, not a concept illustration. Input image 1 is the exact canonical yellow protagonist identity and pixel rendering; input image 2 is its actual small in-game neutral sprite. Reproduce that character, do not redesign. Yellow plump dinosaur, pear-shaped body and cream oval belly, big GREEN eyes, simple small mouth on right-facing snout, short arms, short legs and dark brown claws. Absolutely no horns, no tail, no clothing, no hair, no armor.
Output a square 1024x1024 PNG with REAL transparent alpha background. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate full-body sprites in a perfectly regular invisible 256x256 grid. No grid lines, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no ground, no extra objects, no detached fragments. Row-major reading order.
Maintain a fixed side / slight three-quarter view FACING RIGHT for ALL 16 sprites, never left. Every sprite uses identical body proportions, head size, rendering style and scale. Neutral standing height is 160 pixels in each 256x256 cell. Foot ground line is local y=232 in every cell, root anchor local x=128,y=232. Character feet and belly center remain near root. Do NOT move the character across cells to simulate movement. Give each frame generous transparent margins. Poses change smoothly with anticipation, action and recovery. Feet never clipped. Do not enlarge the character in attack frames. Keep limbs readable with restrained silhouette changes.
These are BODY-ONLY animation frames for later independent VFX layering. No large magic effects, no beam, no slash arcs, no particles or aura. Tiny hand gestures only. Crisp chunky pixel art, dark brown outline and golden shaded body, match reference. All 16 cells must contain exactly one complete same-sized character.
Rows 1-2: eight sequential frames of "超究极武神霸斩", an exaggerated energy sword combo, without a visible giant sword. Row1col1 neutral preparing stance; row1col2 crouch anticipation, right hand slightly back holding a tiny short ivory energy dagger; row1col3 forward horizontal slash body pose, right arm forward; row1col4 second upward slash body pose, arm diagonally up. Row2col1 third downward slash pose, torso lean a little right; row2col2 finishing two-handed overhead chop pose, tiny dagger pointing diagonally down-right; row2col3 recovering, hands lower; row2col4 return to the exact opening neutral stance.
Rows 3-4: eight sequential frames of "极巨化奶光炮", mouth-based charged milk beam. Row3col1 neutral preparing; row3col2 slight knee bend and both hands held near cream belly; row3col3 gathering charge with hands slightly closer to chest, cheeks a little puffed; row3col4 deeper charging with hands braced, eyes concentrated. Row4col1 full-charge hold with both feet planted, mouth beginning to open toward right; row4col2 mouth wide open rightward, short arms braced and torso slightly leaned forward; row4col3 same firing stance with tiny recoil in shoulders, mouth still open. Row4col4 mouth closes, hands lower back to neutral. NO actual emitted beam or glow in this body sheet. Mouth remains around the same horizontal level during the firing pair.
